notes: Initial backpressure-before-pay300 overlaps test compilation, excluded. First after-query300 contains 402 residual PROCESS_INBOX executions; retained as excludedMixedQuery, not the pure-query control. Final query starts after both channel pendingCallbacks/pendingPayments are zero. Comparisons have no parallel build/test load.
Payment capacity excludes terminal-payment notification backlog and refunds. Existing over-limit migration state is preserved.
Admission snapshots are once per diagnostic sample, not instantaneous maxima. Timers are execution means over the diagnostic interval, not end-to-end P99.
Short D0 windows include JIT/cache/shared-host variability; no 300 completionTPS, 2000QPS, D1, long stability, frontend/browser or remoteCI certification.
